registered_title: Nano-Mamba U-Net: A Spatio-Temporal Framework for Cardiac Motion Analysis

scientific_scope.stage_a: Four-class spatial 3D cardiac MRI segmentation trained on independently labelled ED and ES volumes.
scientific_scope.stage_b: The frozen spatial checkpoint is applied to every phase of each validation cine, with independent frame-wise inference and a fixed adjacent-frame probability-fusion baseline. Native-grid masks support volume, phase, EF, smoothness, LV-centroid, and myocardial-radial trajectories.
scientific_scope.input_tensor: B x 1 x 256 x 256 x 16; the last axis is anatomical slice depth, not cardiac time
scientific_scope.serialized_sequence: B x 2048 x 128; 2048 = 32 x 32 x 2 spatial tokens
scientific_scope.output_tensor: B x 4 x 256 x 256 x 16 softmax/logit grid followed by class-axis argmax
scientific_scope.temporal_operation: Circular fixed fusion: 0.25 P(t-1) + 0.50 P(t) + 0.25 P(t+1), applied before argmax
scientific_scope.motion_boundary: Completed outputs are segmentation-derived global trajectories and functional indices. No learned temporal Mamba, registration, optical flow, dense deformation, tissue correspondence, regional strain, or external clinical validation is claimed.
scientific_scope.mamba_boundary: The bottleneck uses kernel-3 depthwise local mixing and a token-wise scalar gate on a fixed raster sequence. It has no recurrent state propagation, selective scan, self-attention, or direct global all-token interaction and is not the reference Mamba/VSS implementation.
scientific_scope.ablation_definitions: The historical No-Mamba model is a zero-Mamba convolutional-bottleneck control. The historical Half-Mamba model uses the same type of gated block at 64 rather than 128 channels; Half refers only to that block width.
scientific_scope.lightweight_definition: Lowest reported trainable-parameter count together with competitive recorded batch-one throughput; no claim of leadership in every accuracy, speed, or peak-memory metric.
scientific_scope.supported_claim: Nano-Mamba provides a compact spatial accuracy-efficiency trade-off; the full-cine extension produces complete global trajectories, and fixed probability fusion makes the LV-volume curve smoother without establishing a resolved Dice or EF gain.

stage_a_order: Load paired NIfTI image and integer-label volumes
Resize image and label to 256 x 256 x 16
Use trilinear interpolation for MRI and nearest-neighbour for labels
Apply per-volume finite min-max MRI scaling to [0,1]
stage_b_order: Discover a four-dimensional NIfTI whose final dimension equals NbFrame in Info.cfg
Extract one X x Y x Z cardiac phase at a time
Apply the checkpoint-compatible resize and per-phase min-max scaling
Compute logits and softmax in float32, retain frame-wise argmax, and store the sealed probability maps on CPU as float16
Use frame-wise probabilities directly or apply fixed circular adjacent-frame fusion
Restore the categorical mask to the original array shape with nearest-neighbour interpolation
Use NIfTI header spacings for physical volume and distance calculations
not_executed: explicit orientation canonicalization or common-spacing resampling
registration, optical flow, dense deformation, tissue correspondence, or strain
image_processing.evaluation_grids: Historical endpoint Dice is measured on the resized 256 x 256 x 16 grid. The cine analysis additionally reports endpoint Dice after nearest-neighbour restoration to native array shape and derives scalar physical metrics from native header spacings.

stage_a_experiment.loss: DiceCELoss(to_onehot_y=true, softmax=true); the default training loss includes background
stage_a_experiment.reported_metric: Case-level Dice for RV, MYO, and LV, followed by model-level means over 40 validation cases
confounders: batch size differs across model families
optimizer-step counts differ with batch size
the zero-Mamba convolutional control and 64-channel gated ablation are not parameter matched to Nano-Mamba

normalization_batch_contract.AttentionUNet: BatchNorm3d, batch size 1; all 150 epochs completed

stage_a_experiment.deterministic_controls: seed 42 for Python, NumPy, PyTorch CPU, and all CUDA devices; cudnn.deterministic=true; cudnn.benchmark=false; both loaders num_workers=0; global deterministic-algorithm enforcement was not enabled

stage_a_evidence.archival_note: Historical command/environment attestation is optional forensics and is excluded from the P2 scientific readiness gate.

stage_a_results.shared_difficult_case: patient049_frame11 is the lowest-mean case for Nano-Mamba and four other model families; Nano-Mamba mean Dice is 57.86% and RV Dice is 26.04%.

stage_b_full_cine.status: complete validation analysis; independent audit pass

outliers.phase_timing: patient016: ED error 5 phases and ES error 3 phases under fusion

stage_b_full_cine.geometry_note: Six recovered official cines have 4D/endpoint affine metadata differences. Shape, zooms, endpoint pixel identity, and endpoint image-label affine agreement pass; scalar physical metrics use header spacings and no dense world-coordinate correspondence is claimed.
stage_b_full_cine.probability_precision_note: AMP was disabled; logits and softmax were float32; frame-wise argmax was preserved before the probability maps were stored as float16 and converted back to float32 for fixed fusion arithmetic.
stage_b_full_cine.native_grid_note: Nearest-neighbour restoration uses the original X/Y/Z shape with no axis permutation. The 6.861 percentage-point frame-wise resized/native difference is not attributed solely to Z anisotropy; resampling in all axes, boundary discretization, heterogeneous native geometry, and model error can contribute.
stage_b_full_cine.pathology_groups: Descriptive only: MINF n=7, NOR n=6, DCM n=4, RV n=2, HCM n=1

presentation_replot.scope: Display-only two-method replot from sealed frame_metrics.csv and patient_metrics.csv; raw audited bundle unchanged.

open_scientific_limits: the validation cohort selected the checkpoint and supplies the final spatial and cine analyses; there is no independent test cohort
only one patient split and one training seed are reported
training used direct array resize without explicit orientation/common-spacing normalization or augmentation
ablations are not capacity, batch-size, normalization, or optimization matched
intermediate cine phases have no manual masks
fixed fusion is not a learned temporal network
HD95, ASD, calibration, and blinded qualitative review were not evaluated
global centroid/radial trajectories are not dense tissue tracking or regional strain
pathology summaries are descriptive because groups are small and imbalanced
the sealed temporal-fusion probability maps used float16 storage before float32 fusion arithmetic, so no precision-independent Dice or EF gain is claimed
